options.html:
Christine Gwinnup, REALTOR, B.A., M.ed
*Social Media Marketing Certification
*Luxury Home Marketing Designation
*Member of The Institute for Luxury Home Marketing
*Data-driven Marketing Specialist

Who is The Little Lady?
Christine's 23 years of Teaching Experience exposed her to the world of data. What did her students know and understand?
Where were the gaps in her teaching style? How could she lean into information
and dive deeper to elevate her student's scores?

A creative problem solver at with an addiction to data, 
Christine left the field of Education, and thrust herself into Sales,
something she knew nothing about. After reading every book she could get her
hands on, and learning what matters about a Sales Process, she quickly became the top
salesperson at one of the best Harley Dealerships in the
United States.  She quickly moved into the Internet Sales Manager Position
and sold 36 bikes in her final month on the floor.

Christine's love for Real Estate kept her buying and selling homes
throughout the years and eventually lead her to earning her Colorado Real Estate license. 
Bringing her knowledge from her past careers with her,
Christine developed her bold and Recognizable Northern Colorado Brand.
Closing 12 transactions in her first year and 28 in her second year is proof
that with education and motivation, almost anyone can succeed in Real Estate.

Christine works with motivated agents helping them
1) Generate Leads for and from their Listings
2) Create a Brand that pushes sales to the next level 
3) Create their Individual Processes
4) Problem Solve difficult Transactions

If you are interested in learning more
Reach out to Christine at 303-709-4262
to see if you may be a good fit!
